headline: ChinaTalk made the case for DUV lithography export controls, as a leaked draft AI regulatory bill reportedly shopped by Anthropic drew criticism and a newsletter warned of stealth malware threats to Defense IT systems.

points.text: A ChinaTalk newsletter interview with Saif Khan made the case for export controls on deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment.
A newsletter warned that stealth malware threat vectors pose a growing risk to Defense Department and federal civilian IT systems.

A leaked draft AI regulatory bill reportedly being shopped around by Anthropic drew criticism as 'unacceptable and troubling,' with critics comparing it unfavorably to the FRONTIER Act over stronger preemption of state laws.
Websites are increasingly closing their doors to autonomous AI agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and others as such agents proliferate online.
A report found a former White House press secretary was linked to an AI rare-earths mining startup tied to a Cabinet secretary, in a story that turned out stranger than it first appeared.
